trial_court: Additional District Judge, Fast Track Court - III, Barrackpore, North 24 Parganas in Matrimonial Suit No. 300 of 2013
facts_of_case: The wife prayed for maintenance for herself and two minor daughters who are residing with her. The husband is employed as UDC (Accounts Section), Sales Tax Department, Government of West Bengal. The trial court directed the husband to pay a sum of Rs. 5,00/- per month to the wife and Rs. 2,500/- each for two minor daughters apart from litigation costs.

legal_principles.principle: While adjudicating the quantum of maintenance, the Court shall not take into account the voluntary deduction allowed to be deducted from the monthly salary by the husband.
legal_principles.held: It is submitted on behalf of the petitioner that the petitioner has to bear the burden of two unemployed brothers and, therefore, the quantum of maintenance awarded by the tribunal is too excessive.

legal_principles.principle: The Court shall consider the income of the husband while determining the quantum of maintenance.
legal_principles.held: The salary certificate annexed to this revisional application reveals that the gross salary of the petitioner for the month of March 2015 is 31,158/-.

outcome.final_order: The trial court's order directing the husband to pay maintenance is upheld.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for maintenance under Section 24 of the Hindu Marriage Act
preparing a response to an application for maintenance in a matrimonial suit
advising on the quantum of maintenance in a divorce case
